🎥🎬: Fightland (2026)

Set against the backdrop of an unforgiving underground fighting circuit, Fightland follows people whose lives are shaped by ambition, loyalty, and the constant pressure to prove themselves. Every fight carries consequences that extend far beyond the arena.

As tensions build between rival groups, trust becomes a rare commodity and survival depends on the choices made both inside and outside the ring. The series blends explosive action with personal drama, revealing the sacrifices required to stay in the game.

With high-stakes confrontations and unpredictable twists, Fightland explores the cost of power in a world where one mistake can change everything.

#Fightland #STARZ #CrimeDrama #ActionSeries #UndergroundFighting

source_details.title: Fightland
source_details.synopsis: Fightland is a boxing crime drama television series created by Daniel Fajemisin-Duncan, Marlon Smith, Damione Macedon and Raphael Jackson Jr.. It premiered on July 31, 2026, on Starz in the United States and August 27, 2026, on Sky Atlantic in the United Kingdom.
